sources.use: Reading/token morphology and romanization remain separate; not copying an unlicensed implementation.

normalization: Only kana base plus adjacent combining/halfwidth dakuten clusters in analysis copy; NFKC. Each transformed UTF16 boundary maps to original or -1 for indivisible cluster. Opaque original identifiers unchanged. No global source normalization.
display_policy: Basic/combined kana chart mappings, preserve legacy wo/wi/we spelling (not full ALA-LC catalog convention).
Explicit prolonged mark becomes macron on immediately preceding plain vowel. Repeated/isolated mark rejected. No arbitrary adjacent-vowel contraction.
Syllabic n apostrophe only before vowel/y; not automatic before n.
Sokuon requires a following chart consonant (ch uses t); terminal/vowel/y/n/r/m unsupported, no silent deletion.
Unlisted ordinary small vowel/y/wa consumes its own chart value; unknown Han/marks and small ka/ke rejected.
Punctuation/literals are outside kana converter, exact original pieces retained.
unchanged: Morphological grouping and narrow copular nan rule
Authored sentence readings, speech, matcher and all production call sites
limits: No new dictionary or semantic improvements promised for contextual Han mistakes.
